commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1
git fetch --no-tags origin main
SOURCE_SHA="af7419f24c96d5c011f57bb730f8db6af163f34b"
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
if gh release view v0.2.3 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "V023_ALREADY_PUBLISHED_CHECK_MANUALLY=true"
  exit 41
fi
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-release023-src-XXXXXX)"
OUT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-release023-out-XXXXXX)"
cleanup() { cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$OUT"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "$SOURCE_SHA"
cd "$WORK"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
grep -q 'versionName = "0.2.3"' app/build.gradle.kts
grep -q 'versionCode = 5' app/build.gradle.kts
echo "STAGE=PREPARE_VERIFIED_023_PRERELEASE"
if [[ -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ]]; then
  export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
  export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
fi
scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight
scripts/bin/test-profile.sh full
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
UNSIGNED="app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk"
test -s "$UNSIGNED"
SIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)"
ZIPALIGN="$(dirname "$SIGNER")/zipalign"
test -x "$SIGNER" && test -x "$ZIPALIGN"
"$ZIPALIGN" -f -p 4 "$UNSIGNED" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
APK="$OUT/ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk"
"$SIGNER" sign --ks "$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" --ks-key-alias androiddebugkey --ks-pass pass:android --key-pass pass:android --out "$APK" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
"$SIGNER" verify "$APK"
CERT="$("$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1)"
test "$CERT" = "fb07493cf97b0a84ec410f7f72f12938b7f9d47151546e15c049c49c27807b11"
(cd "$OUT" && shasum -a 256 "ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk" > SHA256SUMS.txt)
SHA256="$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "SOURCE_SHA=$SOURCE_SHA"
echo "CERT_SHA256=$CERT"
echo "APK_SHA256=$SHA256"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(stat -f%z "$APK")"
cat > "$OUT/RELEASE_NOTES.md" <<EOF
# AI Calls 0.2.3 — MVP preview (Samsung S22+, Android 16)

**Preview only; not a production-qualified default dialer.**

This release fixes the v0.2.2 packaging blocker: the main APK now includes the on-device Wireless ADB pairing and GSM audio-host setup. It adds a guided permissions/SIM workflow, screenshots, and English/Polish language selection.

Source commit: \`$SOURCE_SHA\`.
Installer: \`ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk\`.
APK SHA-256: \`$SHA256\`.
Signing: existing Android Debug certificate, retained for test-build upgrade compatibility; not a dedicated production signing identity.

**Verification scope:** clean Mac host preflight/full test profile and release build/signature verification. Earlier S22+ checks covered Wireless ADB pairing, host startup, language switching, and safe UI tests at earlier commits. No real GSM call was performed against this exact published APK. Incoming two-way GSM audio, STOP takeover, END_CALL after TTS, and outgoing calls must still be accepted on this exact APK before production claims.

Install only on a consenting test phone with rollback available. Model download is separate. Protect ADB pairing and stored call data.

v0.2.2 was withdrawn because its main APK could not self-pair Wireless ADB or start the GSM host. Historical git tag v0.2.2 remains for traceability.
EOF
echo "STAGE=CREATE_GITHUB_PRERELEASE"
gh release create v0.2.3 "$APK" "$OUT/SHA256SUMS.txt" -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --target "$SOURCE_SHA" --title "AI Calls 0.2.3 — MVP preview" --prerelease --notes-file "$OUT/RELEASE_NOTES.md"
echo "STAGE=VERIFY_PUBLISHED_RELEASE_ASSETS"
gh release view v0.2.3 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --json isPrerelease,assets,tagName --jq '{tag: .tagName, prerelease: .isPrerelease, assets: [.assets[].name]}'
VERIFIED="$OUT/verified"
mkdir -p "$VERIFIED"
gh release download v0.2.3 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --pattern "ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk" --pattern "SHA256SUMS.txt" --dir "$VERIFIED"
(cd "$VERIFIED" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$VERIFIED/ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$SHA256"
echo "NEW_RELEASE_ASSETS_VERIFIED=true"
echo "STAGE=WITHDRAW_DEFECTIVE_022_RELEASE_KEEP_TAG"
if gh release view v0.2.2 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gh release delete v0.2.2 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --yes
fi
test -n "$(git ls-remote --tags origin refs/tags/v0.2.2)"
echo "OLD_022_RELEASE_REMOVED_TAG_PRESERVED=true"
echo "NEW_APK_URL=https://github.com/MichalMatu/ai-calls/releases/download/v0.2.3/ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk"
echo "NEW_SUMS_URL=https://github.com/MichalMatu/ai-calls/releases/download/v0.2.3/SHA256SUMS.txt"
echo "PUBLISH_COMPLETE=true"
